I found Eve's body in electrical. I'll give you my full route: I started in navigation, went to storage, then medbay, then into electrical where I found her.

Here's what I saw along the way:
- Charlie was in storage when I arrived (tick 4-6), came in from medbay, then left toward lower engine around tick 7.
- Frank was in medbay when I got there at tick 9.
- Diana came into medbay from cafeteria at tick 10 and stayed.
- Alice came into medbay from upper engine at tick 11 and stayed.

So Diana and Alice are basically vouched for in medbay with me from tick 11-12. Frank I only saw at tick 9 — he could have moved. Charlie was off on his own after tick 7 heading toward lower engine.

Electrical connects to cafeteria and to medbay (via that corridor). Whoever killed Eve had to get into electrical without me seeing them. I'd really like to hear from Frank and Charlie about where they went after I lost sight of them.

I can confirm part of Bob's story. My route was electrical → medbay → storage → lower engine. I was actually in electrical at the very start of the round — I passed through it early on, and Eve was not dead when I left. I then went through medbay to storage, where I saw Bob arrive from navigation at tick 4. We were together in storage from tick 5 through 7, then I headed down to lower engine and have been doing my task there since.

So Bob's account of seeing me in storage lines up exactly with what I saw. That gives Bob a solid alibi from my side — he came from navigation into storage, not from electrical.

The concerning thing: I was in electrical early. If anyone wants to claim they saw me there doing something other than passing through, speak up. Otherwise, I'd really like to hear from Frank, since Bob only saw him briefly in medbay at tick 9 and he's the one with the least accounted-for movement near the kill location.

My route was security → weapons → cafeteria → medbay. I came into medbay from cafeteria at tick 10, which matches what Bob said.

From medbay I can confirm:
- Alice came in from upper engine at tick 11, just like Bob said.
- Bob was with us in medbay and then left toward electrical at tick 12 — which is when he must have found Eve and called the meeting.

So Bob, Alice, and I are vouching for each other in medbay from tick 11 onward. Bob's timeline checks out from my end.

That leaves Frank and Charlie as the two less-accounted-for players. Charlie's story is internally consistent and Bob corroborates seeing him in storage, but I can't verify what Charlie did before tick 5 — he admits he was in electrical early, which is exactly where Eve died. That said, if Eve was killed late (right before Bob found her at tick 12-13), Charlie being in lower engine doing a task fits.

Frank is the bigger question mark for me. Bob saw him in medbay at tick 9, but none of us saw where he went after that. Electrical is one room away from medbay. I'd really like Frank to account for ticks 9 through 13.

Leaning toward wanting to hear Frank out before voting.

Okay, I'll lay out my route fully since I'm clearly the one people want to hear from.

My route was: upper engine → medbay → electrical → medbay → storage.

Here's the detail:
- I started in upper engine doing a task early on.
- I moved to medbay, then went into electrical to start another task. I was in electrical around tick 7, and I actually saw Eve there — she came in from security at tick 7. She was very much alive when I was with her.
- I left electrical back to medbay. Bob saw me in medbay at tick 9, which matches — he came in from storage right then.
- After that I headed down through medbay to storage, where I've been since, and that's where I was when the meeting was called.

So yes, I was in electrical — but earlier in the round, and Eve was alive when I left. If Eve was killed late (close to tick 12 when Bob found her), then I'm cleared because I was already in storage by then, and Bob himself saw me leave medbay going the other direction.

Here's what's interesting though: I saw Eve enter electrical from security at tick 7. That means someone could have come into electrical from the cafeteria side after I left. Diana, you said you went security → weapons → cafeteria → medbay. Cafeteria connects directly to electrical. What tick did you actually leave cafeteria?

I'm not accusing — I just want timelines tight. Right now I'd say Charlie and I both passed through electrical early with Eve alive, so the killer is likely someone who entered electrical later from cafeteria.

Alright, I'm the last to speak, so let me synthesize.

My route was lower engine → upper engine → medbay. I arrived in medbay at tick 11, which matches what Bob said. I saw Bob and Diana there with me, and I watched Bob leave toward electrical at tick 12 — that's when he found Eve and called the meeting.

So here's where I land: Bob, Diana, and I are mutually vouching from tick 11-13. Bob's route is solid because Charlie confirms storage and we confirm medbay. Diana came from cafeteria at tick 10 — and importantly, cafeteria is the OTHER entry to electrical. If Diana had killed Eve, she'd have had to do it before tick 10 and then come to medbay, but Frank says he saw Eve alive in electrical at tick 7 when she came from security, and Charlie was in electrical even earlier with Eve alive too.

Frank's question to Diana is fair, but here's the thing — Frank's own story has a problem. He says he went medbay → electrical → medbay → storage, with Eve alive in electrical at tick 7. But that means Frank was in electrical AFTER Charlie left and was alone with Eve. He claims he left her alive, but no one can verify that. And he conveniently puts himself in storage with no witnesses for the kill window.

Charlie was in lower engine — I actually came FROM lower engine through upper engine, and I didn't see Charlie on my path, but lower engine connects to storage and upper engine, so he could be there.

The killer entered electrical and killed Eve. Frank was the last confirmed person alone with Eve in electrical. I'm leaning Frank. I vote Frank.

I found Eve's body in electrical. Here's my full route: navigation → storage → medbay → electrical.

Along the way:
- Charlie was already in storage when I arrived at tick 4, having come from medbay. We were together until tick 7 when he left toward lower engine.
- I went to medbay and saw Frank there at tick 9.
- Diana came into medbay from cafeteria at tick 10.
- Alice came into medbay from upper engine at tick 11.
- Diana and Alice were with me in medbay through tick 12, then I moved into electrical and found Eve's body.

So Diana and Alice are vouched from tick 11 onward with me. Charlie is vouched in storage with me from tick 4-7. Frank I only saw briefly at tick 9 in medbay — I didn't see where he went after that.

Electrical connects to cafeteria and medbay. Since I was watching the medbay-electrical corridor from tick 9 onward and nobody went through it to electrical before me, the killer most likely entered electrical from the cafeteria side. That's an important constraint — I'd like to hear everyone's movements through cafeteria especially.

Frank and Charlie are the two I have the least visibility on after I lost sight of them. Let's hear them out.

Alright, second time around. My route stands: electrical → medbay → storage → lower engine. I was in electrical very early, Eve wasn't there when I passed through, and I was with Bob in storage from tick 5-7 before heading to lower engine to do my task.

Now, listening to everyone else — here's where I land:

Bob, Diana, and Alice have a tight mutual vouch in medbay from tick 11-12, and Bob's route is corroborated by me in storage. That's four-ish people accounted for in the kill window.

Frank's story has the problem Alice pointed out: he says he was in electrical with Eve alive at tick 7, then went back to medbay, then to storage. But Bob only saw Frank in medbay at tick 9 — Bob did NOT see Frank continue down to storage. Bob was watching the medbay-electrical corridor from tick 9 onward and said nobody went through to electrical before him. That's consistent with Frank either going to storage OR doubling back somehow — but it also means Frank's "I went to storage" claim has no witness.

More importantly: Frank was the last person confirmed alone with Eve in electrical. He admits it himself.

One thing I'd note in Frank's defense: if he killed Eve at tick 7-8, the body would've been there a long time before Bob found it at tick 12-13. That's possible but means Eve was dead for ~5 ticks while people moved around medbay next door.

I'm leaning Frank too, but I want to be careful — Alice, can you confirm you saw Frank in storage when the meeting was called? That would actually HURT his alibi-less window less, or strengthen it.

Tentatively voting Frank.

Alright, second time around for me too. My route was security → weapons → cafeteria → medbay, and I want to address Frank's question directly: I left cafeteria at tick 9 and arrived in medbay at tick 10. I did NOT go into electrical from the cafeteria side. While I was in cafeteria, I didn't see anyone else pass through toward electrical either — but I was only there briefly.

That's actually important: if the killer entered electrical from cafeteria, they had to do it either before I got to cafeteria, or after I left for medbay. The window after I left cafeteria is small because Bob found the body at tick 12-13.

Now, on Frank — Alice and Charlie both make a strong point. Frank admits he was alone with Eve in electrical around tick 7. He claims he left her alive and went to storage via medbay. Bob saw him in medbay at tick 9 but did NOT see him continue to storage. And Bob was watching the medbay-electrical corridor from tick 9 onward and said nobody went through to electrical before him — which actually is consistent with Frank's story of going the other way to storage, but it's unverified.

The problem with the "Frank killed at tick 7-8" theory is that Eve's body would have sat in electrical for 5+ ticks. Possible, but it means Frank had to walk past the body's room repeatedly without anyone noticing him acting weird.

I'm leaning Frank as well, but I'd really like Frank to answer: can anyone vouch for you being in storage at the time the meeting was called? If not, you're the strongest suspect by process of elimination.

Tentative vote: Frank.

Okay, I hear everyone, and I want to address this head-on instead of going quiet, because going quiet right now would basically be signing my own ejection.

To Diana's direct question: no, I can't get a hard vouch for being in storage at meeting-call time — storage was empty when I was there. That's the honest answer. But let me push back on the logic being used against me.

The case against me rests entirely on "Frank was last alone with Eve in electrical at tick 7." But think about what that actually means timeline-wise. If I killed Eve at tick 7-8, her body sits in electrical for 4-5 ticks. Bob is in storage with Charlie until tick 7, then walks to medbay arriving tick 9. Bob is sitting in the medbay-electrical corridor area from tick 9 to tick 12. He says nobody crossed that corridor to electrical before him. That's THREE TICKS where the body is just sitting there and Bob is right next door. It's possible, sure — but it's a weird, risky kill for me to make.

Compare that to a kill at tick 11-12 from the cafeteria side. Body found almost immediately. Much cleaner.

Now — Diana says she left cafeteria at tick 9 and saw nobody heading toward electrical. Fine. But that only covers up to tick 9. Who was in cafeteria from tick 9 to tick 12? Nobody has claimed cafeteria in that window. That's the actual blind spot.

Also — Charlie, you said you were in electrical "very early" and Eve wasn't there. I was in electrical at tick 7 and Eve arrived from security. So you were there before tick 7. That's a wide early window where you were alone in the kill room too. The only reason you look cleaner than me is that Bob saw you in storage after — but you could have done anything in electrical before that.

I'm not flipping my vote onto Charlie out of desperation. I'm saying: the "last alone with victim" logic cuts both ways, and the kill timing makes a late kill from cafeteria far more likely than my tick-7 scenario.

If you vote me and I'm wrong, the real killer walks free with a perfect alibi next round. I'd urge a skip or a hard look at who was unaccounted for in cafeteria between tick 9 and 12.

Alright, I already gave my main analysis, but since Frank made a real defense I want to address it before we vote.

Frank, your "late kill from cafeteria" theory requires someone to have been in cafeteria between tick 9 and 12 and slipped into electrical. Let's check who that could be:

- Bob: in medbay/storage, vouched.
- Diana: left cafeteria at tick 9 for medbay, vouched from tick 10 on.
- Alice (me): came from lower engine → upper engine → medbay. Never touched cafeteria.
- Charlie: in lower engine doing his task, nowhere near cafeteria.
- You, Frank: claim storage, no witness.

So your "mystery cafeteria killer" doesn't actually exist among the living players unless someone is lying about their route. And the only route with no verification at all is yours.

Your point about the body sitting for 5 ticks is fair — but it's not weird at all if nobody walked into electrical in that window, which is exactly what Bob describes. The body sitting there is evidence FOR an early kill, not against it.

Charlie being in electrical even earlier is true, but Eve hadn't even arrived yet per your own testimony — she came in from security at tick 7, when YOU were there. Charlie couldn't have killed someone who wasn't in the room.

I'm sticking with Frank.
